title: VaultDeviceRepository
responsibility: Holds enrolled Credential Vault phone devices and their roles, issues single-use challenges and verifies signed device proofs.

inputs.name: VaultDeviceRepository.constructor.devices
inputs.description: Enrolled phones with role and P-256 signing key.

inputs.name: VaultDeviceRepository.constructor.origin
inputs.description: Approval origin the phones sign for.

inputs.name: VaultDeviceRepository.constructor.seal
inputs.description: Signature adapter; defaults to a new VaultSealAdapter.

inputs.name: VaultDeviceRepository.constructor.now
inputs.description: Clock in Unix milliseconds; defaults to Date.now.

inputs.name: VaultDeviceRepository.authenticate.path
inputs.description: Device route the proof was signed for.

inputs.name: VaultDeviceRepository.authenticate.proof
inputs.description: Device id, challenge nonce, payload and signature.

inputs.name: VaultDeviceRepository.authenticateDecision.binding
inputs.description: The scope the broker recorded for the request.

outputs.name: VaultDeviceRepository.issue
outputs.description: A single-use base64url nonce and its expiry, 30 s ahead.

outputs.name: VaultDeviceRepository.authenticate
outputs.description: Returns nothing when the V1 proof verifies; the nonce is consumed either way.

outputs.name: VaultDeviceRepository.authenticateDecision
outputs.description: Returns nothing when the V2 proof verifies; the nonce is consumed either way.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 401 'Device is not enrolled.' when the proof's device id is not pinned.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 403 'The device role does not allow approvals.' for a recovery device.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 429 'Too many device challenges.' when 64 unexpired challenges are outstanding.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 401 'Device proof is invalid or expired.' when the nonce was not issued to this device, was already used, is past its 30 s window, or the signature does not verify.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: 'Invalid device key.' when an enrolled signing key is not a 65-byte uncompressed P-256 point.

outputs.name: VaultDeviceRepository.issue
outputs.description: A single-use base64url nonce and its expiry, 30 s ahead.
